title: Application Date and the First Day of a Recall Paid-Month Credit
content:
For a TRICARE Retired Reserve plan under the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, whether the day the recall paid-month credit is counted from is itself counted follows the application for that active duty enrollment: where the recall paid-month credit is counted from the enrollment's effective date or from the first day of the month and the enrollment was applied for on or before that day, that day is the first day counted; where it is counted from either of those days and the enrollment was applied for after that day, the first day counted is the day after the application date; otherwise the first day counted is the day after the day the recall paid-month credit is counted from.

The active duty enrollment is the recalled purchaser's TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment; its application date is read from its TRICARE Prime record.

**Cases (hypothetical, May).**

- Counted from the effective date of 12 May; applied for on 12 May - the first day counted is 12 May.
- Counted from the effective date of 12 May; applied for on 20 May - the first day counted is 21 May.
- Counted from 1 May, the first day of the month; applied for on 30 April - the first day counted is 1 May.
- Counted from the plan's termination date of 19 May - the first day counted is 20 May, whatever the application date.
